---
name: Letter looks wrong
about: A letter or word is drawn in the wrong shape or order, or the pen path looks wavy or unclean
title: "[letter] "
labels: stroke-quality
---

<!--
This is the most useful feedback for the stroke data. The more exact you are about *which* letter
and *what* is wrong, the faster it can be fixed. Remember that data is regenerated from the
recordings by the tools, never edited by hand, so a fix usually means a change to the tool (for
Hindi, the cleanup) or a re-recording by a native writer.
-->

**Language**

<!-- Malayalam / Hindi -->

**Letter or word**

<!-- Paste the exact text, e.g. ढ्ढ  /  ഴ്ച. If it only goes wrong inside a word, give the word. -->

**What is wrong?**

- [ ] The pen path is wavy or has a kink / knot (say where: the round part, a junction, the stem...)
- [ ] A line that should be straight is slanted or bent
- [ ] The strokes are drawn in the wrong order (e.g. the vertical line should come last)
- [ ] A dot or mark (nukta, anusvara...) is in the wrong place or drawn at the wrong time
- [ ] The headline (shirorekha) is wrong or crosses a mark it should skip
- [ ] A stroke is missing or extra
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

**Details and a screenshot**

<!-- A screenshot of the demo, or a short recording, with the speed slowed down if you can. -->

**Are you a native writer of this script?**

<!-- Not required, but it helps to know how much weight to give a question about stroke order. -->
